resources.string: Each recording is saved here first; every finished part is copied to the network folder, checked, and then removed from this device.
Space to Use on This Device
The newest part of each recording waits here until it\'s copied. If the network folder can\'t be reached for a while, a recording stops cleanly once this fills up, keeping what it has.
A shared folder on a computer or NAS on your home network. Recordings go in it.

Use the computer\'s IP address (names often aren\'t found). On Windows, share the folder with Read/Write for that user and set the network to Private. If this box\'s VPN is on, it may need your home network let through.
Letting the folder past the VPN (it reconnects), then checking…
Type the computer\'s address and the shared folder\'s name, like \\\\192.168.1.20\\Recordings
Couldn\'t save it on this device. Try again.
Look for computers and NAS boxes on your home network, then pick a folder.
Computers and NAS boxes with file sharing on your home network.
Pick the computer or NAS to save recordings on.
Nothing found. Check the computer or NAS is turned on, on the same network, and has file sharing turned on, then search again. Or type its address.
This TV isn\'t on a home network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet), so there\'s nothing to search.
This box\'s VPN is on, so some computers may not show up. If yours isn\'t listed, type its address instead.
Use the account you sign in to that computer or NAS with. Leave both empty for guest access.
No shared folders were found. Share a folder on that computer or NAS, or type its address and the shared folder\'s name.
Pick where recordings go. Open a folder to go inside it.
Type a folder name without \\ / : * ? " < > or |
